name: traccar
summary: GPS tracking and fleet-management platform for device telemetry, geofencing, and location-aware workflows.
why_it_matters: Traccar preserves useful telematics capability knowledge, but there is no current validated workflow that justifies active maintenance as a supported resource.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs device or fleet tracking.
Operators want a telematics backend with geofencing and location history.
The workflow depends on GPS-device integrations rather than generic map storage.

platform_support.notes: The service can run in containers, but useful support depends on device protocols, persistence, and operator workflows around location data.

prerequisites: Validated test device or sample telemetry source
Clear privacy and retention rules for location data
implementation_notes: Promotion should validate one real device or telemetry path.
Keep platform operations distinct from business logic built on top of location data.
Location-history ownership and data policies should be explicit.
operational_notes: Device onboarding and protocol support drive real complexity.
Validation should include a real track ingest and retrieval flow.
Retention and privacy requirements matter for telematics data.
risks: Protocol breadth creates a misleadingly large support surface.
A generic wrapper would imply stronger device compatibility than tested.
